newsitem.title: USA: Wall Street stocks hold strong, recouping losses.
newsitem.headline: Wall Street stocks hold strong, recouping losses.

text.p: Wall Street stocks held convincingly to gains on Tuesday after yesterday's sell-off, which was sparked by concerns about a possible Japanese sale of U.S. government bonds and profit-taking.
The Dow industrials were up 65 points at 7670, below session highs but moving well beyond its session low of 7608. Nasdaq was up eight points at 1442.

"The market sold off too quickly yesterday," said Peter Coolidge, senior equity trader at Brean Murray & Co. "Then, after the initial run-up, traders have been watching to see if stocks would move up further or give up gains."
